title: When gratitude feels distant in the day as it is
issueStatement: The heart notices absence faster than gift. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru keeps gratitude close to remembrance, contentment, and restored vision. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Hardship is not automatically holy, but it can become the place where reality is finally faced. Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement.
actionPrompt: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
